subject: [PATCH v6 05/19] selftests/mm: make the swap cases' swapout reliable

2026-09-19.patch_summary: This patch improves the reliability of swapout operations in selftests/mm by introducing a retry mechanism to handle cases where MADV_PAGEOUT is best effort and khugepaged may still be working on the range. The patch adds a new function `swapout_range` that retries swapping out a range up to two seconds, holding it out of khugepaged's reach meanwhile. If the pages still won't swap out after retrying, the test skips the operation. This change aims to prevent false negatives in the selftests due to timing issues and kernel bugs.
